items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Toulouse or something like that. ... I never did go there because I was, I was too young at that time.

ctx.x: I didn't go there. That was on, uh, what, what street was that on? Toulouse or something like that.
Jumaine and Tanty's. Jumaine, Jumaine and Toulouse or somewhere.

Yeah, right in there. Yeah, I, I never did go there because I was, I was too young at that time. You see, like I say, I had to put on long pants with this band to get into that band and play these things. Because, uh, I mean, I, to get into Union and all like that, I mean, I had to grow up fast, in other words.
